channel.title: Mali - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Mali, every source cited.

item.title: Mali army and Russian corps kill over 200 livestock
item.description: More than 200 cattle and sheep were killed by the Malian army and Africa Corps near Diéma on October 28.

item.title: Bamako families fear for missing relatives amid rising murders
item.description: Police investigate three murder cases while families search for missing loved ones, with one student missing since October 12.

item.title: Malian higher education paralysed by strike
item.description: Teachers demand a research bonus promised nearly a decade ago, halting classes nationwide.

item.title: AS Réal Bamako draws CAF Confederation Cup group stage opponents
item.description: The Malian club will face USM Alger, CS Sfaxien, and Black Bulls in group D.
